page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge belongs to the High Clock Speed instance family, built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 96 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. Memory capacity totals 384.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. There are no onboard graphics processing units included with this instance profile.

Storage configuration for the ecs.hfg7.24xlarge provides no bundled local disks, requiring dependencies on external block storage services for root and data volumes. In terms of network performance, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting high-throughput inter-node communications and external data transfers. The instance does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard virtual private cloud routing or assigned elastic IPs for external access.

With its high clock-frequency CPU configuration and substantial 96-core parallel capacity paired with 384.0 GB of memory, the instance delivers sustained compute capabilities alongside general-purpose memory density. The lack of local storage requires network-attached storage integration, which trades local drive latency for decoupled storage elasticity. This profile is engineered for CPU-bound applications needing high clock frequency, large-scale multithreaded computation, enterprise web serving, distributed batch processing, and high-concurrency database backends.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor using x86_64 architecture. Powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processors running at 3.3 GHz, it delivers 96 dedicated vCPUs alongside 384.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no integrated local storage and features zero GPUs, utilizing networked storage volumes for persistent data needs. Network throughput is provisioned with a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth, facilitating intensive multi-node distributed communication. Given its combination of high single-core operating clock rates and large-scale parallel core counts, this server type is structured for compute-intensive enterprise workloads, large multithreaded simulation tasks, high-traffic web applications, compilation clusters, and memory-balanced database architectures.
